guarantees.claim: b1, b0, q1, q0, m11, m10 are always the 2-bit slices b[3:2], b[1:0], q[3:2], q[1:0], m1[3:2], m1[1:0] respectively.

uncertain_points.claim: The 2-bit mask slices m11 and m10 are intended as re-usable intermediate results; downstream logic that combines these slices may need to preserve the masking scheme to avoid higher-order leakage.
uncertain_points.cond: when m11 and m10 are used in combinational paths that process the shares jointly without independent masking
uncertain_points.risk: potential glitch-based or joint-statistic leakage if mask bits are not processed separately with sufficient randomness
